title: PRD: fake-jev v1 — deterministic local test server for System One-style decision APIs
objective: Decompose the published v1 PRD (PRD.md in this work item) into bounded, independently verifiable work items covering specification phases 0-4, and drive them through verify-candidate.
acceptance: PRD.md covers all seven agreed modules: engine, jev/v1 profile, configuration, HTTP host, control API, CLI, contract artifacts and golden harness
PRD.md user stories, implementation decisions, testing decisions, out-of-scope and further-notes sections are all present
One child work item exists per specification § 31 phase slice (0-4), each with objective, specReferences, allowedFiles, acceptance, nonGoals and verificationCommands
No child work item requests a feature listed in specification § 33 deferred decisions
Every child work item's acceptance criteria traces to a specification section or a § 44 golden contract vector
nonGoals: This item does not implement product code; implementation happens in the child work items it creates
No TypeScript wrapper (phase 5) or WASM work (phase 6)
No redesign of the specification or of the architecture it defines
nextAction: Orchestrator reads PRD.md, then creates .agent/work/FJ-<NNN>/state.json for each § 31 phase slice and flips those to ready.
notes: Triage label ready-for-agent maps to status "ready" in this tracker (see docs/agents/triage-labels.md).
PRD was authored from the user's confirmed module breakdown: all seven modules in scope for tests.
